title: Zesty Smoky Mediterranean Lamb Kebabs
description: A smoky and flavorful Mediterranean dish featuring lamb, unwaxed lime, and a blend of spices, perfect for a midnight craving. This paleo-friendly recipe is served on a wooden board.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice, olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto the soaked wooden skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until they reach an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Transfer the kebabs to a wooden board and sprinkle with chopped fresh oregano.
